title: Your Body Clock Makes You Tired At The Same Time Every Day
hook: Your body has a master clock, making you tired at predictable times.

narration.text: Your internal body clock, your circadian rhythm, dictates when you feel tired.
This amazing system is controlled by a tiny brain region, the suprachiasmatic nucleus.
It receives signals about light and darkness from your eyes.
These signals help it synchronise your sleep-wake cycle with the 24-hour day.
When light fades, the nucleus tells your body to produce sleep-inducing melatonin.
This is why you might feel a natural dip in energy in the early afternoon.
It is not just about how much sleep you had; your body has a schedule.
Have you noticed your energy levels dip at similar times each day?

description: Ever wondered why you feel sleepy at the same time every day, regardless of your activities? It is all down to your body's amazing internal clock, regulated by a tiny but powerful part of your brain called the suprachiasmatic nucleus.
topic: Why your internal body clock makes you feel tired at certain times, explaining the suprachiasmatic nucleus.
